instructions.value: During Reduce trials participants interpreted the image to minimize their emotional response; during Maintain trials they noticed their feelings without trying to change them.

stimuli.value: IAPS images rated 2 to 3.5 on valence and 5 to 7 on arousal.

spans.text: During the “Rate Emotion (1–4)” prompts, participants rated their distress on a 1–4 scale (1=no distress to 4=severe distress) using a response box placed in their right hand.
The magnitudes and reaction times for each rating were collected as behavioral data.
